decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core pipeline-components business for existing customers, it is cheap to maintain and still has credible option value in a growing market.

Although it uses the firm's metalworking and coating capabilities, the public waste bin sits outside the core product-market focus and is likely to lose out to better-fitting uses of capacity once its prospects have become clearer.
This variant is even more niche than a standard waste bin and, after several years, the firm would likely judge the remaining upside as too limited relative to its core infrastructure business.
A standalone outdoor ashtray is the most distant and narrowest option in the set, so real-options logic points to abandoning it once market learning has not justified stronger commitment.
